summary: Iran announced defensive strikes against US military bases following American airstrikes on Iranian provinces, while a US strike on a wedding ceremony in Kohestak, Hormozgan killed 5 and wounded 68 civilians including children. Israel arrested Hamas's Head of Shabak in Gaza City and killed two Hamas military security operatives, with IDF raising alert levels along the Gaza border amid increased helicopter activity.
key_points: Iran's Foreign Ministry condemned US aggression and announced defensive strikes against US military bases in response to American airstrikes on multiple provinces including Khuzestan, Sistan and Baluchestan, Hormozgan, and Kerman. (Source: @naya_foriraq/89222)

A US strike on a wedding ceremony in Kohestak, Sirik district, Hormozgan province killed 5 and wounded 68 civilians, including at least 15 children, according to Iranian state media. (Source: @mamlekate/104287)
Israeli Shin Bet forces arrested Mouin al-Arabid, the Head of Hamas's Shabak (internal security), in an operation conducted exclusively by Shin Bet in central Gaza. (Source: @New_security8200/203572)
IDF killed Talal Mustafa Saleh Badawi, commander of Hamas's military security department in Gaza City Brigade, and Momen Saeed Mohammed Al-Hawari in a Monday strike. (Source: @manniefabian/59084)

Jordanian military intercepted 10 out of 13 ballistic missiles from Iran that entered Jordanian airspace, with the remaining three falling in remote areas causing no casualties. (Source: @mamlekate/104295)
Hezbollah launched two explosive-laden drones at Israeli occupation forces in southern Lebanon amid expanding Israeli offensive operations. (Source: @presstv/205258)
Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu stated Israeli forces control 60% of the Gaza Strip following the capture of Hamas's security chief. (Source: @amitsegal/64492)
A Saudi shipping company reported two Filipino crew members killed when their vessel was attacked in the Strait of Hormuz on Monday. (Source: @asafroz/53010)

sections.executive_summary: Iran executed defensive strikes against US military bases following American airstrikes on multiple Iranian provinces, marking a significant escalation in direct military confrontation. A US strike on a civilian wedding in Kohestak, Hormozgan killed 5 and wounded 68 including children, drawing condemnation from Iranian authorities and the Red Crescent Society. Israel arrested the Hamas Head of Shabak in Gaza City and eliminated two Hamas military security commanders, with IDF raising alert levels along the Gaza border amid increased combat helicopter activity. Regional tensions are elevated with Hezbollah attacking Israeli troops in southern Lebanon and Jordan intercepting Iranian missiles.

points: Iran's Foreign Ministry issued a statement condemning US aggression and announced defensive strikes against US military bases that served as launch points for American attacks on Iranian territory, citing Iran's inherent right to self-defense under international law. (Source: @naya_foriraq/89222)

A US strike targeted a wedding ceremony in Kohestak, Sirik district, Hormozgan province, killing 5 and wounding 68, with at least 15 of the wounded being children, according to Iranian state media and officials. (Source: @mamlekate/104287)

Iranian Red Crescent Society President called on the ICC Prosecutor to take legal action following the US bombing of the Kohestak wedding ceremony, citing violations of international humanitarian law. (Source: @presstv/205220)
An explosion was reported in Kermanshah Province with eyewitnesses believing it was an airstrike, though details remain limited and unverified at this time. (Source: @shin_persian/9405)
Three Basij members were killed in a US attack on Lavan Island: Mehdi Bahrani, Hossein Salehnia, and Hassan Momeni, according to images published by IRGC-affiliated media. (Source: @kianmeli1/91461)
US Secretary Scott Bessent stated the US would sever every tie Iran has to the outside world, declaring 'all hands on deck' in the administration approach to Iran. (Source: @shin_persian/9416)

Shin Bet forces arrested Mouin al-Arabid, serving as the Head of Hamas's Shabak (internal security service), in an operation conducted solely by Shin Bet without militia involvement, with security services tracking him for an extended period before the opportunity arose. (Source: @New_security8200/203572)

IDF killed Talal Mustafa Saleh Badawi, a commander in Hamas's military security department within the Gaza City Brigade, and Momen Saeed Mohammed Al-Hawari, another Hamas operative, in a strike justified as targeting those violating the ceasefire by advancing attacks. (Source: @manniefabian/59084)

IDF raised alert levels along the Gaza Strip border overnight, with increased Apache helicopter activity over northern Gaza due to concerns Hamas might respond to the arrest operation in central Gaza. (Source: @almogboker78/18112)

Prime Minister Netanyahu stated Israeli forces control 60% of the Gaza Strip following recent operations, with the capture of the Hamas security chief expected to yield valuable intelligence. (Source: @amitsegal/64492)

Sirens sounded in northern border communities due to a suspicious aerial target crossing from Lebanon into Israeli territory, with interceptor missiles launched and results under review with no injuries reported. (Source: @manniefabian/59082)
Israeli drone struck a tent in the Mawasi area of Khan Yunis, according to Gaza reports, though no casualty details were provided. (Source: @New_security8200/203575)

Shin Bet arrested the Head of Hamas's Shabak in an operation described as highly compartmentalized, initially planned to keep details concealed, though reports and media footage from Arabic media forced disclosure. (Source: @New_security8200/203572)

IDF killed two Hamas military security operatives in Gaza City on Monday, with the military justifying the strike by stating both were advancing attacks on troops and civilians and working to restore Hamas capabilities in violation of the ceasefire. (Source: @manniefabian/59084)
Israeli drone activity targeted a tent in the Mawasi area of Khan Yunis, though no specific casualties were reported in the available messages. (Source: @New_security8200/203575)
Increased Apache helicopter activity was reported overnight along the northern Gaza Strip as IDF raised alert levels along the border following the Shabak head's arrest. (Source: @almogboker78/18112)

Hezbollah fighters launched two explosive-laden drones at Israeli occupation forces in southern Lebanon, representing a direct attack as Israel continues expanding its offensive deeper into the region. (Source: @presstv/205258)

A suspicious aerial target crossed from Lebanon into Israeli territory, triggering sirens in northern border communities, with the IDF launching interceptor missiles and results under review. (Source: @manniefabian/59082)
A local Beirut time update message included prayers for mujahideen but contained no operational details about military activities in Lebanon. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/388402)

Live warplane activity was reported along the southern coast with the mention of southern Lebanon in aviation tracking maps, though specific operational details were not provided. (Source: @redlinkleb/40220)
Satellite imagery shows a large burned area at a US military compound adjacent to Erbil International Airport in the Kurdistan Region of Iraq, according to reports. (Source: @naya_foriraq/89232)

A major fire broke out at the Khabat electricity power plant in Erbil, Iraq, though the cause and connection to military activities were not specified in available messages. (Source: @kianmeli1/91462)
An Israeli drone struck a tent in the Mawasi area of Khan Yunis, though this report from Gaza does not directly concern Syrian or Iraqi territory. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/388371)

CNN reported at least four people killed in last night's attacks, including a child at a wedding celebration, with a civilian airport also targeted, though US CENTCOM declined to comment on the attack rationale. (Source: @kianmeli1/91455)

Saudi Arabia's national shipping company announced two Filipino crew members were killed when their vessel was attacked in the Strait of Hormuz on Monday, marking a significant maritime security incident. (Source: @asafroz/53010)
The US Embassy in Saudi Arabia issued an advisory urging American citizens in the Middle East to exercise caution given the current regional tensions. (Source: @kianmeli1/91452)

Jordanian military intercepted 10 out of 13 ballistic missiles from Iran that entered Jordanian airspace, with three others landing in remote areas away from population centers, causing no casualties. (Source: @mamlekate/104295)

Trump claimed the Strait of Hormuz is under US control and suggested renaming it 'Trump Strait' while stating it would be 'hotter' than ever, on his Truth Social platform. (Source: @SharghDaily/181519)

sections.threat_assessment: The Iran-US conflict has escalated to direct military confrontation with Iranian defensive strikes against US bases following American airstrikes on multiple Iranian provinces. The strike on a civilian wedding in Hormozgan, killing 5 and wounding 68, represents a significant escalation that Iran is framing as a war crime, with the ICC being called to intervene. Hezbollah's drone attacks on Israeli forces in southern Lebanon indicate the conflict is expanding geographically, while Jordan's active interception of Iranian missiles demonstrates regional state involvement in the escalating tensions. Israel's arrest of the Hamas security chief and elimination of two military security commanders suggests intensified pressure on Hamas leadership, though this may provoke retaliatory responses.
sections.regional_response: Jordan has emerged as an active participant by intercepting 10 of 13 Iranian ballistic missiles that entered its airspace, demonstrating willingness to defend against regional escalation. Saudi Arabia faces indirect exposure through attacks on its shipping in the Strait of Hormuz, where two Filipino crew members were killed, raising concerns about maritime security in the region. The US Embassy in Saudi Arabia has advised American citizens to exercise caution, while Trump publicly claimed US control over the Strait of Hormuz. Regional actors are calibrating responses based on the scope of Iranian retaliation and potential for sustained direct confrontation between the US and Iran.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Iranian retaliation operation, while framed as defensive strikes, represents a deliberate escalation by Tehran against US military assets following what Iran describes as attacks on civilian infrastructure. The US claim of intercepting 'most' Iranian missiles contrasts with Jordan's more definitive 10-of-13 interception rate, suggesting variable defensive success across the region. The timing of the US carrier Abraham Lincoln's port call in Thailand after over 200 days at sea may indicate a planned rotation rather than operational withdrawal. The arrest of the Hamas Shabak chief represents a significant intelligence success for Israel, with the operational security around the arrest suggesting high-value intelligence was anticipated from interrogation.
